observed_result.criterion: With cert-authority,principals="hm:fx-enroll:enroll" <fixture CA> added by a preimage-checked, atomic, marker-tagged transaction: principal hm:fx-enroll:enroll rc 0; principal enroll (the username) rc 255 (principals= restricts); ops from our CA rc 255 (the seed's ops line trusts a different CA key; also checked before our line exists); without the line rc 255. Unrelated lines byte-identical; seed SHA-256 restored after removal by marker. Fail: any acceptance of enroll or ops; any change to unrelated bytes.
observed_result.summary: Observed on fixture enroll (account-owned authorized_keys, preimage = seed sha256 5c4670f1...): before our line, the hm:fx-enroll:enroll certificate rc 255 and our CA's ops certificate rc 255 against the seed's own cert-authority,principals="ops" line (different CA key; certificate evaluated, no principal reason logged). Added cert-authority,principals="hm:fx-enroll:enroll" <fixture CA> by compare-and-swap on the preimage digest, temp file and atomic rename (rc 0; after-add bytes = preimage + 1 line). Then: hm principal rc 0 (Accepted with ID); enroll (username) rc 255 and ops (our CA) rc 255, both logged 'Certificate does not contain an authorized principal'; bare key rc 255; the pre-existing admin key still worked. Removal by marker rc 0; after-remove bytes identical to the preimage, sha256 = seed, owner:mode enroll:600, no temp files left; hm certificate rc 255 afterwards. Verdict pass.
